# Reference results from release 2.0.0

These files are immutable reference outputs retained from the verified
2.0.0 handoff. They are not regenerated by GitHub Actions. New runs should
write to the ignored `results/` directory and should be compared against
these records rather than overwriting them.

The ARC suite files in `arc3/` record a static audit of the 25 local
environments that accompanied the private handoff. The downloaded game
sources themselves are deliberately excluded from the public repository.
